title: Add the linear masking rate and the corrected t to the 84-field code, with tests
headline: Five build items let the four rows run, and the default table is done
setup: The model fills a team's 84 fields one pass at a time. This ticket adds five pieces of code, called build items, so that each of the four rows can be trained, sampled and battled. A row is one way to train and sample the model.
alt: Five build items: two training arms, the corrected t option, the guidance setting, the ask-grid rows and random order. One part of the first is done: training already reads the shuffled-only table by default. Each item has one test.
terms: One way to train and sample the model. Four are compared. The control is Per-field, uncorrected t: our own settings
One piece of code this ticket adds. There are five, numbered in frame 2
A named training run in the code. This ticket adds one for each masking rate
The training teams whose win-rate labels come only from battles that shuffle a team's six Pokémon
How hard the sampler pushes toward the win rate asked for. 1 is no push, and higher pushes harder
The t at which training hid as many fields as are still hidden at this pass
Teams an earlier run already sampled and battled, kept on disk. New code must reproduce them

items.text: Training arms: under the linear rate, the share hidden at t is t
Corrected t: matches the check script's value at every pass
Guidance: guidance 2 reproduces a stored cell

Random order: the existing lookahead tests pass

frames.takes: Each build item has one test that checks the one thing it must do.
frames.expected: All five pass before any training starts.
frames.surprise: Guidance 2 fails to reproduce a stored cell, so the new setting changed old behaviour.
